items.finding: Failure handling strategy is undefined for counter store unavailability, and the incident shows failing closed blocks all traffic.
Fixed window algorithm allows double the limit at window boundaries, violating contract wording about 'any rolling 60-second period'.
Two Redis round trips exceed the 5ms p99 latency budget given cross-AZ network latency and Redis operation times.
Using server clocks with known skew for window keys causes inconsistent rate limiting across servers.
Design only covers standard tiers but not enterprise customers with contract-specific limits like peak-hour adjustments or burst allowances.
Response format lacks required Retry-After and X-RateLimit headers that client SDK documentation states are mandatory.
Redis replication lag could cause inconsistent rate limiting if reads go to replicas during failover scenarios.
Monitoring lacks circuit breaker state tracking and doesn't alert when rate limiting enters degraded operation mode.
